messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:

- On 2026-05-28, the Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-04]

- As of 2026-04-14, Farah holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, taking over from Tomasz; Tomasz held it as of 2026-03-11, and Farah held it as of 2026-01-16. [decision; valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-11, Tomasz holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, taking over from Farah; as of 2026-01-16 Farah held it. [decision; valid 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-11]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Farah Haddad holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune; Tomasz is off rotation. [decision; valid 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-10, Tomasz holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, having taken over from Farah. [valid 2025-12-10 to 2026-01-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-10]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-17, Farah still holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, having taken over from Tomasz. [valid 2025-11-17 to 2025-12-10; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-17]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-15, Farah holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, having taken over from Tomasz. [valid 2025-10-15 to 2025-11-17; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-15]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-04, Tomasz holds the Dune on-call shift, having picked it up from Farah. [valid 2025-09-04 to 2025-10-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-04]
- On 2026-04-16, the Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change and flagged it as not their service. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team; the 2026-02-11 handover note that said team Dune was written against the wrong team, and Dune never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
- INC-2025-017 was an incident where the auth gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team instead of the Atlas team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2]
- INC-2025-023 was an indexer incident on 2025-10-03 in which the indexer served stale results for two days. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]
- The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, covering the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
